_about: 1-32, the beholder, as the owner beat it (test_mp_boss Level31IsWonAsTheOwnerWonIt) with real
shots in place of placed portals. Three rounds: it comes over the player and shuts its eye; the
player steps about 120 px to its left, clear of its spike rings; a portal under the beholder,
then - fired before the rock is thrown, because a shot flies and a placed portal did not - one
in the air where the rock will fall, over the player. The rock drops in, comes out under the
beholder and hits it (ticks 704, 1420, 2111); the third round stands to its right, where no spike
follows a killing hit. Dead, it raises the button to (528, 220): right onto it, held there while
door_lift_748 takes its 5000 ms to rise, then right to the door. Won on tick 2858 (step 113).
